localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
Group Camp - maximum of 40 people, No RVs or trailers permitted, train noise, vault toilet on site, 200 yard walk to flush toilets and showers There is a small picnic shelter with picnic tables and a fire ring. Parking is limited. Car pooling is encouraged.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: S1-South Shelter
localizedValues.description:
The S1-South Shelter is closest to the amphitheater and has electrical outlets, barbecue grill, and eight covered picnic tables. The amphitheater is available on a first come first served basis and does not come with the shelter rental. Note: Your reservation does not guarantee parking. Parking is limited; please arrive early or carpool.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
PLEASE NOTE: If your group is conducting special activities other than simple gatherings (i.e. special set up like canopies, amplified music, professional filming/photography, using a drone, commercial/business use, serving alcohol, and or having vendors like food trucks/caterers), you MUST contact the Park at paige.pike@parks.wa.gov or call 360-899-7203 regarding a special activity permit at least 60 days in advance of your event. Failure to do so or groups exceeding maximum occupancy can result in the cancellation of your event.
Hold Site
